name: Lennar Corporation
moat_justification: Second-largest U.S. homebuilder with real scale (national procurement, ~488k controlled homesites, land-light model with 98% of homesites controlled and ~0.1 years owned, even-flow manufacturing cutting cycle time to a record 116 days, integrated Financial Services with ~83% mortgage capture) — against a commodity product with no switching costs or network effects, no through-cycle pricing power (incentives ~12% of price in Q3 FY2026, home-sales gross margin 27.5% in FY2022 -> 15.8% in Q3 FY2026), land bought in a competitive open market at rising cost, and demand hostage to mortgage rates and affordability that the company does not control.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 11 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 3.8%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:shares — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended November 30, 2025, Earnings Per Share note: 'Denominator for basic and diluted earnings per share — weighted average common shares outstanding 257,746' (in thousands) for FY2025 (FY2024 272,019, FY2023 283,319 in the same table); the same combined basic-and-diluted denominator is reported in the Q4/FY2025 earnings release. Lennar reports a single basic-and-diluted denominator (no dilutive securities outstanding; the filing states there were no antidilutive options for FY2023-2025).); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share -0.52 vs 3-yr median 7.56 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.2x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
one_liner: Second-largest U.S. homebuilder with a real land-light/scale moat, 4/10 — but the cycle has crushed cash earnings: TTM OE is only $2.77/share (FY2025 OE was negative on an inventory-driven OCF collapse) and Q3 FY2026 orders fell 9% with home-sales gross margin at 15.8%, so at $78.43 the weighted IRR is only 6.74% (IV@15% $25.90); it clears the 15% hurdle only below ~$26.
moat_for: #2 U.S. homebuilder by deliveries — national procurement and subcontractor scale
Land-light model: ~98% of homesites controlled via options/land banking, ~0.1 years of owned homesites — balance-sheet risk through troughs is structurally lower
Even-flow manufacturing: cycle time cut to a record 116 days, construction cost per sq ft down 6% YoY in Q3 FY2026
Integrated Financial Services (~83% mortgage capture) captures margin beyond the home sale and funds rate buydowns that defend volume
Sustained buyback: share count shrinking 3.8%/yr, credited in the growth blend
moat_against: Commodity product — no switching costs, no network effects; buyers choose on price, location and rate buydown
No pricing power through the cycle: incentives ~12% in Q3 FY2026, home-sales gross margin fell from 27.5% (FY2022) to 15.8% (Q3 FY2026) on higher land costs
Land is bought in a competitive open market — management attributes the entire margin gap to land cost
Demand is hostage to mortgage rates and affordability, neither company-controlled; Q3 FY2026 orders -9% YoY and FY2026 delivery guidance was cut
Capable, well-capitalized rivals (D.R. Horton #1, PulteGroup, NVR's structurally higher-ROE land-light model)

overrides.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended November 30, 2025, Earnings Per Share note: 'Denominator for basic and diluted earnings per share — weighted average common shares outstanding 257,746' (in thousands) for FY2025 (FY2024 272,019, FY2023 283,319 in the same table); the same combined basic-and-diluted denominator is reported in the Q4/FY2025 earnings release. Lennar reports a single basic-and-diluted denominator (no dilutive securities outstanding; the filing states there were no antidilutive options for FY2023-2025).
